whatIs: Eyecandy is a library of visual techniques from film, video and motion, such as dolly zoom, datamosh, parallax or match cut. Each technique has a short definition and a grid of clips from music videos, ads and movies where it's used.
It's useful for putting a name to an effect you saw and finding more examples, or for looking for ideas before animating a website, a product video or a presentation.
uses: Look for references of transitions or camera movements before animating a landing page hero.
Find out what an effect is called so you can then search for a tutorial or a library that reproduces it.
Put together a motion moodboard to agree on the tone of a product video with your team.
caveats: It's video inspiration: it has no code, templates or files to download.
The clips belong to their authors and are shown for educational purposes, so they can't be reused without permission.
pricingNote: Free and ad-free; an account is only needed to take part by submitting techniques.
idealFor: Anyone who designs motion and wants references with proper names.
